entries.name: Potassium ethyl xanthate
entries.usefulness: Proposed ICM role: sulfide-ore flotation collector separate from the frother. It is the neutral potassium salt, not the isolated xanthate anion or other alkyl-chain collector.

entries.name: Oxalic acid (anhydrous)
entries.usefulness: Proposed ICM role: rare-earth separation research and an oxalate-intermediate branch. Equilibrium-study results are modeled evidence; no process dosage or recovery is specified.

sources.title: Sigma-Aldrich 194131: Oxalic acid
sources.supporting_text: Identity gives ethanedioic acid, CAS 144-62-7, linear HO2CCO2H and InChI composition C2H2O4; this is not the dihydrate.
sources.license_basis: Uncopyrightable factual identity and original factual paraphrase only; no copied tables, substantial text, or manufacturer performance guarantee.

facts.value: An original solution-equilibrium study examines oxalic acid as a precipitant for cerium, neodymium and yttrium ions.

sources.title: Zhang, Noble, Ji and Li: Effects of contaminant metal ions on precipitation recovery of rare earth elements using oxalic acid; repository date 2022-01-01
sources.supporting_text: The original study uses solution-equilibrium calculations for Ce, Nd and Y precipitation by oxalic acid. Its abstract reports interference from trivalent aluminium and iron and consequent changes in reagent requirements; these are modeled results, not universal measured capacities.
